transcript: I'm very patient with myself. I allow myself to learn. I allow myself to develop patience, forces me to stay true to myself. Patience has given me the pathway to deconstruct, to mold, to shift, and to remain steady because I know that impatience gifts always arrive and they arrive at my doorstep. I do not have to force my life in any direction and I don't have to chase anything because everything that's for me presents itself to me because I'm patient.
